blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Education (DepEd) on Friday underscored the unprecedented scale of laptop distribution to public school teachers under the administration of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. This comes after the Chief Executive and Education Secretary Sonny Angara led the ceremonial turnover of newly procured MacBook Neo laptops to public school teachers at Mabini Elementary School in Iloilo City. In a statement, Angara said the massive laptop deployment nationwide fulfills the directives of President Marcos to ensure the welfare of Filipino educators while ensuring quality education nationwide. “First time din na magbibigay ng ganitong karaming laptop sa ating mga […]...
